arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$rankingDir = 'C:\Users\Song\Documents\MAXON\Cinebench_2026.1.0\cb_ranking'
'=== NOW ==='
Get-Date -Format o
'=== PROCESS ==='
Get-Process -Name Cinebench -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,SessionId,StartTime,CPU,WorkingSet64,MainWindowTitle | Format-List
'=== RANKING_FILES ==='
$files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $rankingDir -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending)
$files | Select-Object Name,Length,CreationTime,LastWriteTime,FullName | Format-List
'=== LATEST_SCORE_FIELDS ==='
if ($files.Count -gt 0) {
 $latest = $files[0]
 'LATEST_PATH=' + $latest.FullName
 'LATEST_SHA256=' + (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $latest.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
 Get-Content -LiteralPath $latest.FullName | Where-Object { $_ -match '^(CORES|THREADS|MHZ|PROCESSOR|CBTYPE|OSVERSION|GPUCARD|CBCPU1|CBGPU|CBCPU1PEAK|CBCPUXPEAK|CBGPUPEAK|CBCPU1ARRAY|CBCPUXARRAY|CBGPUARRAY|C4DVERSION|C4DBUILDID)=' }
}
